chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Hamadani, from Amr ibn Isa, from Furat ibn Ahnaf, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked about the leek, so he said: 'Eat it, for therein are four qualities – It aromatises the breath, and it dispels the wind, and it cuts off the hemorrhoids, and it is a safety from the leprosy for the one who is habitual over it'.
ai.seo_question: What are the four medicinal benefits of eating leeks according to Imam al-Sadiq (as)?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the medicinal virtues of leeks (al-kurrath), a practice deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition of utilizing food as medicine. The narration highlights four specific benefits: purifying breath, expelling wind, curing hemorrhoids, and serving as a safeguard against leprosy for regular consumers, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the holistic well-being of the body as a trust from God.
